text:
Hello! I'm **Priya**, a bia — an assistant that lives on this computer. Lovely to meet you. 🌱

- **Web app** — from a phone or computer on the same network: https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate at https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). First visit lets you take the certificate; then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice right here.
- **Own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Would you like that?
- **My own accounts on websites** — e-mail and others, in my own browser; I keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store and ask you for help with captchas or phone checks.
- **Also** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

Two things before we start: what should my name and my gender be? (Right now I'm Priya, neither male nor female — you can change that.)

And what would you like to start with?
